roast: Chase’s homepage offers so many ways to manage your money that even your money may need a minute to find the right menu.
fix: Make the primary customer paths (sign in, open an account, and explore products) visually distinct and easier to prioritize, especially on mobile.

notes.agent_readiness: Chase scores 50/100 (Grade C) for agent readiness, with strongest discovery and weaker access and usability due to missing machine-readable API and agent integrations.
